_comment: Maps variant labels to the bare ULID portion of each session's JSONL filename in ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-daniel-Coding-Rust-tama--/. The full filename is date-prefixed: <date>_<ulid>.jsonl. Discovery rules: Qwen baseline = branch ends in 'qwen' AND first user message mentions plan-175; temp 0.5 = branch ends in 'temp-0.5'; temp 0.3 (aborted #1, #2) = two sessions on 'laguna-s-2.1' with NO 'git branch -m' rename AND last assistant stopReason != 'stop', sorted by session.timestamp ascending; temp 0.7 = most recent session on 'laguna-s-2.1' that has 'git branch -m ... temp-0.7-top-p-0.95'.
